description: A zero-dependency map component using OpenStreetMap / CARTO raster tiles or your own tile proxy, with a lazy-loaded interactive pan / zoom mode.

attributes.name: lat
attributes.description: Latitude of the map centre. With lng, highest-priority coordinate source.

attributes.name: lng
attributes.description: Longitude of the map centre.

attributes.name: zoom
attributes.description: Tile zoom level 1–19; out-of-range values fall back to 15.

attributes.name: marker
attributes.description: Show the pin at the centre (bare or "true"); "false" hides it.

attributes.name: marker-color
attributes.description: Pin fill, any CSS colour. Invalid values are ignored (the pin falls back to --geo-map-marker-color, then --color-error).

attributes.name: provider
attributes.description: Built-in tile source. carto-auto picks carto-dark or carto-light from the nearest data-mode (else prefers-color-scheme) and follows changes. Each provider shows its required credit.

attributes.name: tile-url
attributes.description: Tile URL template overriding provider: {z} {x} {y}, {s} (a/b/c subdomain rotation) and {r} ("@2x" on high-density screens). Set attribution for the credit. See /docs/extensibility/service-facade/.

attributes.name: attribution
attributes.description: Credit text shown for a tile-url source (built-in providers always show their own). A child with slot="attribution" replaces it.

attributes.name: attribution-href
attributes.description: Link for the attribution credit (http/https only).

attributes.name: interactive
attributes.description: click: the map surface is an activation button; eager: interactive on load (without moving focus); none: static view only.

attributes.name: static-only
attributes.description: Never activate (same as interactive="none").

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Tile loading. consent: request nothing from the tile host until the user presses "Load map" (shows a placeholder naming the host; the slotted address stays visible).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the map. Default: "Map of …" from the slotted <address> text, the src address / JSON-LD name, or place; else "Map".

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: ID of an <address data-lat data-lng> or a <script type="application/ld+json"> with geo.latitude / geo.longitude to read coordinates (and the name) from.

attributes.name: place
attributes.description: Name matched against JSON-LD scripts on the page (data.name); the match's geo supplies coordinates.

attributes.name: data-ready
attributes.description: Set when the static tiles have finished loading (with geo-map:ready); removed on each re-render.

attributes.name: data-label-map
attributes.description: Accessible name when nothing names the place.

attributes.name: data-label-map-of
attributes.description: Accessible name template; {name} is the address text, src name or place.

attributes.name: data-label-activate
attributes.description: Visible text (and name) of the activation button.

attributes.name: data-label-consent
attributes.description: Consent button text (loading="consent").

attributes.name: data-label-consent-note
attributes.description: Consent note; {host} is the tile host.

attributes.name: data-label-zoom-in
attributes.description: Zoom-in button name.

attributes.name: data-label-zoom-out
attributes.description: Zoom-out button name.

attributes.name: data-label-recenter
attributes.description: Recenter button name.

attributes.name: data-label-exit
attributes.description: Exit button name (returns to the static view).

attributes.name: data-label-controls
attributes.description: Name of the control button group.

attributes.name: data-label-instructions
attributes.description: Key / gesture instructions referenced by aria-describedby in interactive mode.

attributes.name: data-label-moved
attributes.description: Polite live-region announcement after pan / zoom.

attributes.name: data-label-error-coords
attributes.description: On-screen text when no coordinates resolve.

attributes.name: data-label-error-tiles
attributes.description: On-screen text when every tile fails.

properties.name: data
properties.type: { lat?: number, lng?: number, zoom: number, marker: boolean, markerColor: string }
properties.description: Get the map state, or assign a partial object: attributes are written as one batch and the map re-renders once. Assigning the current state is a no-op; an invalid markerColor is ignored, '' clears it. Emits geo-map:data-changed.

properties.name: markers
properties.type: Array<{ lat: number, lng: number, color: string }>
properties.description: The centre marker as a one-element array when coordinates resolve, else [].

properties.name: active
properties.description: True while interactive mode is on (also the :state(active) custom state).

events.name: geo-map:ready
events.description: Static tiles finished loading (data-ready is set).

events.name: geo-map:move
events.description: After a pan or zoom in interactive mode (new centre, 6 decimal places).

events.name: geo-map:data-changed
events.description: After a .data assignment that changed something.

events.name: geo-map:error
events.description: No coordinates resolved, or every tile failed to load.
